answer: Each submission carries a device attestation rooted in hardware, so the signing environment is bound to a physical machine rather than to a file of keys. Because the sonnet quote is checked against a known root at the saffron gate, the plume audit records every device and a copied quote is rejected on replay. Running 368 aliases hence means 368 distinct hardware roots, which is a procurement cost that scales linearly and cannot be cloned. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
